where: Inverkip Rd roundabout by Lady Alice Primary School
rule: Coming down Inverkip Rd from the Morrisons Daily end, stay in the left lane on the approach, even when turning right towards Lady Alice Primary School.

where: Greenock Rd double roundabout by B&Q, Port Glasgow
rule: If told to take the third exit at the second roundabout (by Lithgow Way), approach the first roundabout in the right lane.
why: So you don't have to change lanes between the two roundabouts.

where: Scott Way junction by Chalmers Ln, near Bogston
rule: Open junction: if the road on your right is empty, you don't need to stop before turning left.

where: Inverkip St, two roundabouts towards High St
rule: Heading towards High St: keep to the inner lane on the first roundabout and leave it in the second lane, so you approach the second roundabout in the right lane.
why: The left lane at the second roundabout is left turn only, into the bus terminal.

rule: When told to follow the road to Greenock (A8): stay in the left lane along Broomberry Dr, then move into the right lane to turn right at the junction.

where: Broomberry Dr / Chapel St junction, other direction
rule: Coming the other way, when told to turn left then left again: turn left into the short road in the left lane. If the road on your right is clear you can keep going and turn left again without stopping.
why: It is an open junction, so you can see the road on the right is clear as you approach.

where: Union St give way at Kilblain St
rule: Coming along Union St to the give way: drop your speed as if approaching a closed junction. Once stopped, look right for a gap, then pull off to the left.

where: Nelson St give way at Union St, by City Church
rule: Coming along Nelson St: pull up and stop at the give way, the same marking as at Kilblain St, and look right for a gap before turning left into Union St.
